about: Answer key for the skill catalog (scripts/eval/skill-catalog.ts). Question ids are from the 2026-11-04 production snapshot. The hard tier is scored: Devin's approved groups (2026-11-05), adjusted for his split of the AI questions into supervised coding and unsupervised processes. The open tier is reported, not scored: Devin wants to see where these land. Cases are new requirements distilled against a catalog applied from a plan; 'with' names a question whose skill the case must map to, 'not' names questions whose skills it must not map to.

apart.label: AI in products and agents are not supervised coding
Narrow or vague AI questions are not supervised coding
Temporal is not workflow orchestration engines in general
Accessibility is not accessible UI and product instincts
Terraform is not infrastructure as code in general

open.label: LLMs and AI in products (approved group)
